rice.name: Rice (Paddy / వరి / धान)
rice.suitable_soil: Fertile clayey loam or silty clay soils with good water retention capacity. Optimum soil pH 5.5 to 7.0.
rice.sowing_and_spacing: Kharif sowing in June-July, Rabi in Nov-Dec. Spacing: 20x15 cm or 15x15 cm for SRI method. Seed rate: 20-25 kg/acre (transplanted), 30-35 kg/acre (direct seeded).
rice.water_and_irrigation: Submerged/standing water (2-5 cm) needed during tillering and panicle initiation. Critical stages: Tillering, Panicle Initiation, Flowering, and Grain Filling. Drain water 7-10 days before harvest.
rice.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK recommendation: 40-50 kg Nitrogen, 20-25 kg Phosphorus (P2O5), 20-25 kg Potash (K2O) per acre. Apply Zinc Sulphate 10-15 kg/acre basal. Split Nitrogen: 50% basal, 25% active tillering, 25% panicle initiation.

common_pests.name: Stem Borer (కాండం తొలిచే పురుగు / तना छेदक)
common_pests.symptoms: Dead hearts in vegetative stage (central leaf sheath dies and dries up); White ears/white panicles at reproductive stage (chaffy grain heads).
common_pests.ipm_practices: Install pheromone traps (5/acre for monitoring, 10-12/acre for mass trapping). Release Trichogramma japonicum egg parasitoids. Clip seedling leaf tips before transplanting.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If dead heart exceeds 10% threshold: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre in 200L water OR Cartap Hydrochloride 4G granules @ 7-8 kg/acre.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Wear mask and rubber gloves. Do not apply during heavy winds or immediate rainfall risk. Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 14 days.

common_pests.name: Brown Plant Hopper (BPH / సుడి దోమ / भूरा फुदका)
common_pests.symptoms: Circular patches of dried, burnt crop known as 'Hopper Burn', typically at the base of the plant in dense fields with excessive nitrogen.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Create 'alleyways' (1 ft gap every 2 meters) for aeration and sunlight. Avoid excessive urea application. Drain standing water from the field for 3-4 days.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If 10-15 hoppers per hill: Pymetrozine 50% WDG @ 120 g/acre OR Trifluflumuron / Dinotefuran 20% SG @ 80-100 g/acre directed towards the plant base.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Direct spray to the base of the crop canopy. Wear protective eyewear. Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 21 days.

common_pests.name: Leaf Folder (ఆకు చుట్టు పురుగు / पत्ती लपेटक)
common_pests.symptoms: Leaves folded longitudinally with white transparent streaks where green tissue has been scraped off.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Pass a rope across the crop canopy during early tillering. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If leaf damage > 10%: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre OR Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 20 ml/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Spray in early morning or late evening. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Blast Disease (అగ్గి తెగులు / ब्लास्ट रोग)
common_diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped elliptical lesions on leaves with brown/reddish borders and grey centers. Neck blast causes blackening and breakage of panicle necks.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Treat seeds with Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 2g/kg seed. Avoid excess nitrogenous fertilizer; apply potash in balanced doses.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: At first sign of leaf spots: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 120-160 g/acre in 200L water OR Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 300 ml/acre.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Ensure complete canopy coverage. Do not spray during hot midday sun. PHI: 21 days.

common_diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB / బాక్టీరియల్ ఆకు ఎండు తెగులు)
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked wavy lesions starting from leaf tips down the margins, turning yellow-white, with bacterial ooze drops visible in morning dew.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Drain excess water. Avoid clipping seedling tips in BLB-prone areas. Avoid overhead irrigation.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 300-400 g/acre mixed with Streptocycline @ 6g/acre in 200L water.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Wash hands thoroughly after handling. Wear face mask. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Sheath Blight (కాండం కుళ్ళు / పల్లా తెగులు)
common_diseases.symptoms: Greenish-grey water-soaked oval or irregular spots on the leaf sheath near the water line, enlarging with brown borders like snakeskin.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Maintain wider plant spacing. Apply balanced NPK with adequate potash. Destroy stubble.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 400 ml/acre OR Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 200 ml/acre in 200L water.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Direct spray towards the lower stem and sheath. PHI: 15 days.

rice.weather_sensitivity: Heavy rain at flowering causes spikelet sterility and grain washing. Prolonged cloudy weather and high humidity (>85%) drastically increases Blast and BLB risks.

cotton.name: Cotton (పత్తి / कपास)
cotton.suitable_soil: Deep black cotton soils (vertisols) or fertile well-drained loams with pH 6.5 to 8.0. Sensitive to waterlogging.
cotton.sowing_and_spacing: Sowing in May-June (irrigated) / June-July (rainfed). Spacing: 90x60 cm or 120x45 cm for Bt hybrids. Seed rate: 1-1.5 packets (450g each) per acre.
cotton.water_and_irrigation: Sensitive to waterlogging. Critical irrigation stages: Square formation, Flowering, and Boll development. Drip irrigation saves 40-50% water.
cotton.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 48-60 kg N, 24 kg P2O5, 24 kg K2O per acre. Split N into 3 doses (basal, 30 days, 60 days). Foliar spray of 2% DAP or 1% 19:19:19 + 1% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) at peak flowering.

common_pests.name: Pink Bollworm (గులాబీ రంగు కాయ తొలిచే పురుగు / गुलाबी सुंडी)
common_pests.symptoms: Rosette flowers (petals twisted into rosette), premature boll opening, stained lint, small exit holes on mature bolls with damaged seeds.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Install Pink Bollworm pheromone traps (5/acre for monitoring, 8-10/acre for mass trapping). Destroy crop residues immediately after final harvest.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If 8 moths/trap/day or 10% rosette flowers: Profenofos 50% EC @ 400 ml/acre OR Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 80-100 g/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Never spray without protective respirator mask and gloves. Keep cattle away. PHI: 15-20 days.

common_pests.name: Sucking Pests (Aphids, Jassids, Whiteflies, Thrips / రసం పీల్చే పురుగులు)
common_pests.symptoms: Leaf curling (downwards in aphids, upwards in thrips/whiteflies), yellowing, honeydew excretion causing sooty mold, leafhopper yellow marginal burning.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Set up yellow sticky traps (whitefly/aphid) and blue sticky traps (thrips) @ 10 traps/acre. Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) early.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If ETL reached: Flonicamid 50% WG @ 60-80 g/acre OR Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 240 g/acre OR Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 40-50 g/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Alternate chemical groups to prevent pesticide resistance. Spray underneath leaves. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (కోణీయ ఆకుమచ్చ తెగులు)
common_diseases.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots on leaves bounded by veins, black arm lesions on branches, water-soaked round spots on bolls.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Acid delinting of seeds. Avoid excessive nitrogen. Remove crop debris.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 300g + Streptocycline @ 6-8g per acre in 200L water.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Ensure thorough coverage. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Alternaria Leaf Spot & Grey Mildew (ఆల్టర్నేరియా ఆకుమచ్చ / బూడిద తెగులు)
common_diseases.symptoms: Concentric brown target-board rings on leaves leading to premature leaf shedding. Grey mildew produces powdery whitish growth on leaf underside.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Maintain proper plant spacing for aeration. Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Mancozeb as prophylactic.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 100g/acre OR Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 200 ml/acre.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Do not spray in midday heat. Wear mask and eye protection. PHI: 15 days.

cotton.weather_sensitivity: Heavy unseasonal rain during boll bursting discolors lint and rots bolls. High humidity with temperature >30°C triggers heavy bollworm and sucking pest infestations.

tomato.name: Tomato (టమోటా / टमाटर)
tomato.suitable_soil: Well-drained sandy loam or clay loam rich in organic matter. Optimum pH 6.0 to 7.0.
tomato.sowing_and_spacing: Year-round in three seasons (Kharif, Rabi, Summer). Spacing: 60x45 cm or 75x60 cm for indeterminate varieties. Seed rate: 50-80 g/acre (hybrids).
tomato.water_and_irrigation: Regular, uniform moisture is essential. Avoid alternate wet-dry cycles which cause Blossom End Rot and fruit cracking. Drip irrigation with fertigation is highly recommended.
tomato.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 60-80 kg N, 40-50 kg P2O5, 50-60 kg K2O per acre. Apply Calcium Nitrate 10 kg/acre and Boron 1 kg/acre during flowering to prevent blossom end rot.

common_pests.name: Fruit Borer (కాయ తొలిచే పురుగు / फल छेदक - Helicoverpa)
common_pests.symptoms: Circular bore holes in developing and ripe tomato fruits with larval excreta around the entrance.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Plant marigold as a trap crop (1 row marigold for every 16 rows tomato). Install Helilure pheromone traps @ 5/acre.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If damage exceeds 5%: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre OR Spinosad 45% SC @ 60-70 ml/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Follow strict Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 3 days for Spinosad, 5 days for Chlorantraniliprole before harvesting ripe fruit for consumption.

common_pests.name: Tomato Leaf Miner (టుటా అబ్సొల్యూటా / Tuta absoluta)
common_pests.symptoms: White blotch/blister-like mines on leaves with dark frass; pin-hole entries in fruits near calyx.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Install Tuta ferolure delta traps @ 12-16 traps/acre. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre OR Cyantraniliprole 10.26% OD @ 360 ml/acre.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Wear mask and gloves. PHI: 5 days.

common_pests.name: Whitefly & Sucking Pests (తెల్లదోమ)
common_pests.symptoms: Yellowing of foliage, sticky honeydew, vector for Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) causing stunted crinkled leaves.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Install yellow sticky sheets @ 15-20/acre. Cover nursery beds with 40-mesh nylon nets.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 200 ml/acre OR Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 240 g/acre.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Spray underside of foliage. PHI: 5 days.

common_diseases.name: Early Blight (ముందస్తు ఆకు ఎండు తెగులు / अगेती झुलसा)
common_diseases.symptoms: Brown to black spots on older leaves with characteristic concentric rings ('bullseye' pattern), surrounded by a yellow halo.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Mulch the soil surface to prevent soil splash onto lower leaves. Remove lower diseased leaves. Avoid overhead sprinkling.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 400 g/acre prophylactic OR Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 200 ml/acre in 200L water.

common_diseases.name: Late Blight (ఆలస్యపు ఆకు ఎండు తెగులు / पछेती झुलसा)
common_diseases.symptoms: Rapidly spreading water-soaked dark irregular patches on leaves and stems with white cottony fungal growth on underside under humid conditions.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Ensure good drainage. Monitor closely during cold humid weather (night <18°C, day <25°C, humidity >80%).
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 400 g/acre OR Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 400 g/acre in 200L water.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Act immediately upon first symptom. PHI: 7 days.

common_diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt (బాక్టీరియల్ వడలు తెగులు)
common_diseases.symptoms: Rapid wilting of the entire plant without initial yellowing of leaves. White milky bacterial stream oozes from cut stem in clean water.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops (maize, pulses). Soil solarization. Use resistant varieties.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Drench root zone with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.5g/L.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Remove and burn wilted plants immediately. Do not contaminate irrigation water.

tomato.weather_sensitivity: Rain + high humidity (>80%) triggers explosive Late Blight and fruit rot. Temperatures >35°C cause extensive flower drop and poor fruit set.

wheat.name: Wheat (గోధుమ / गेहूं)
wheat.suitable_soil: Well-drained fertile loamy and clay loam soils with neutral pH (6.5 to 7.5).
wheat.sowing_and_spacing: Optimum sowing: November 1st to 20th. Spacing: 20-22.5 cm row-to-row. Seed rate: 40-50 kg/acre.
wheat.water_and_irrigation: 4 to 6 irrigations depending on soil. 6 Critical stages: 1. Crown Root Initiation (CRI - 21 days after sowing - most crucial), 2. Tillering (40-45 DAS), 3. Late Jointing (60-65 DAS), 4. Flowering (80-85 DAS), 5. Milking (100-105 DAS), 6. Dough stage (115-120 DAS).
wheat.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 48-60 kg N, 24 kg P2O5, 16 kg K2O per acre. Apply 1/3 N + Full P & K at sowing; 1/3 N at CRI stage; 1/3 N at jointing stage. Apply Zinc Sulphate 10 kg/acre basal.

common_pests.name: Termites / White Ants (చెదలు / दीमक)
common_pests.symptoms: Drying of seedlings, yellowing and wilting; damaged roots show chewed fiber.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Seed treatment with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 4 ml/kg seed. Avoid un-decomposed farmyard manure.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If standing crop affected: Fipronil 0.3% GR @ 8 kg/acre broadcast before irrigation OR Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 1.2 L/acre with irrigation water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Avoid direct skin contact. PHI: 30 days.

common_pests.name: Wheat Aphid (పేనుబంక / माहू)
common_pests.symptoms: Colonies sucking sap from leaves and earheads during grain filling, causing shrivelled grains.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Encourage ladybird beetles and syrphid fly predators.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If >5 aphids/earhead: Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 40g/acre OR Dimethoate 30% EC @ 300 ml/acre.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Spray during evening to protect pollinating bees. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Yellow / Stripe Rust (పసుపు కుంకుమ తెగులు / पीला रतुआ)
common_diseases.symptoms: Yellow powder pustules arranged in parallel stripes along leaf veins, staining fingers yellow when touched.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Grow rust-resistant varieties. Monitor fields in cold humid sub-mountain regions.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 200 ml/acre in 200L water OR Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 200 ml/acre upon first yellow stripe.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Ensure protective mask is worn. PHI: 30 days.

common_diseases.name: Karnal Bunt & Loose Smut (కర్నాల్ బంట్ / कांगियारी)
common_diseases.symptoms: Loose smut replaces grains with black powdery mass of fungal spores. Karnal bunt emits fishy odor with partially converted black powdery grains.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Seed treatment with Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% DS @ 2.5g/kg seed.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Prophylactic spray of Propiconazole 25% EC @ 200 ml/acre at earhead emergence stage.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Do not consume infected grains. PHI: 30 days.

wheat.weather_sensitivity: Sudden heat spike (>30°C) during February-March causes terminal heat stress, accelerating maturity and causing shrivelled light grains.

chilli.name: Chilli (మిరప / मिर्च)
chilli.suitable_soil: Well-drained sandy loam or black soil with good fertility, pH 6.5 to 7.5.
chilli.sowing_and_spacing: Nursery in June-July, transplant in July-August (Kharif) or Oct-Nov (Rabi). Spacing: 60x60 cm or 75x45 cm. Seed rate: 100-150 g/acre (hybrids).
chilli.water_and_irrigation: Frequent light irrigations. Never allow water stagnation (causes rapid root rot). Drip irrigation is ideal.
chilli.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 60-80 kg N, 30-40 kg P2O5, 40-50 kg K2O per acre. Top dress Nitrogen and Potash in 4 equal splits. Micronutrient spray (Formula-4 / Zinc + Boron) at flowering.

common_pests.name: Thrips (తామర పురుగులు / थ्रिप्स - Scirtothrips dorsalis & Black Thrips)
common_pests.symptoms: Upward curling of leaves (boat-shaped), crinkled brittle foliage, brownish silvery patches under leaf surface and on fruits.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Install blue sticky traps @ 20-25/acre. Spray 5% Neem oil (10,000 ppm) @ 2 ml/L early.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If heavy infestation: Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 160-180 ml/acre OR Broflanilide 300 SC @ 20 ml/acre OR Fipronil 5% SC @ 350-400 ml/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Alternate modes of action to prevent rapid resistance. Wear PPE. PHI: 5-7 days.

common_pests.name: Mites (నల్లి / माइट्स - Yellow/Broad Mite)
common_pests.symptoms: Downward curling of leaves (inverted boat shape), elongated petioles ('rat tail' appearance), bronzing of foliage.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Avoid excessive synthetic pyrethroids. Maintain field humidity.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 200 ml/acre OR Fenpyroximate 5% EC @ 300 ml/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Spray thoroughly targeting lower leaf surface. PHI: 5 days.

common_diseases.name: Dieback & Anthracnose / Fruit Rot (కొమ్మ ఎండు మరియు కాయ కుళ్ళు తెగులు)
common_diseases.symptoms: Twigs die from tip downwards (dieback); circular sunken dark blemishes on green and ripe fruits with concentric fungal rings.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Seed treatment with Thiram 3g/kg. Collect and burn infected dried twigs and rotten fruits.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 200 ml/acre OR Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 200 ml/acre in 200L water.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Wear mask and gloves. PHI: 5 days.

common_diseases.name: Chilli Leaf Curl Virus (ఆకు ముడుత వైరస్)
common_diseases.symptoms: Severe curling, puckering and reduction of leaf size, bushy stunted plants with few deformed fruits.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Control whitefly and thrips vectors early using sticky traps and recommended sprays. Rogue out infected plants.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Vector control: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 240g/acre. No chemical cures viral infection directly.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Do not compost virus-infected plants. Burn safely.

chilli.weather_sensitivity: Heavy rains and waterlogging cause immediate dieback and Phytophthora root rot. Extended cloudy humid days trigger explosive anthracnose fruit rot.

groundnut.name: Groundnut (వేరుశనగ / मूंगफली)
groundnut.suitable_soil: Well-drained loose, friable sandy loam or red loamy soil with pH 6.0 to 7.5. Loose soil is essential for easy peg penetration.
groundnut.sowing_and_spacing: Kharif: June-July; Rabi/Summer: Nov-Dec. Spacing: 30x10 cm. Seed rate: 45-55 kg kernels/acre.
groundnut.water_and_irrigation: Critical irrigation stages: Flowering, Pegging (35-45 DAS), and Pod development (55-75 DAS). Moisture stress at pegging reduces yield by 50%.
groundnut.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 10-12 kg N, 20-25 kg P2O5, 20 kg K2O per acre. Mandatory Gypsum application: 150-200 kg/acre at pegging (40-45 DAS) for calcium to develop solid pods without pops.

common_pests.name: Red Hairy Caterpillar & Spodoptera (ఎర్ర గొంగళి పురుగు / तंबाकू की सुंडी)
common_pests.symptoms: Gregarious caterpillars defoliate entire plants, leaving only bare stems.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Set up light traps and bonfires at first monsoon rain to kill moths. Dig trenches around field borders to trap marching caterpillars.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If larvae are grown: Novaluron 10% EC @ 300 ml/acre OR Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 80-100 g/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Wear protective gear. Keep domestic animals away. PHI: 14 days.

common_pests.name: White Grub (వేరు పురుగు / सफेद लट)
common_pests.symptoms: Larvae feed on underground rootlets and pods, causing sudden wilting and death of patches of plants.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Deep summer ploughing. Seed treatment with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 10 ml/kg seed.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: Soil application of Fipronil 0.3% GR @ 8-10 kg/acre at sowing or drenching with Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 1 L/acre.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Wash skin immediately if exposed. PHI: 30 days.

common_diseases.name: Tikka Leaf Spot (తిక్కా ఆకుమచ్చ తెగులు - Early & Late)
common_diseases.symptoms: Dark brown circular spots on upper leaf surface with yellow halos (early tikka); small black carbonaceous spots without halos (late tikka).
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Seed treatment with Carbendazim 2g/kg seed. Crop rotation with cereals.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 300 ml/acre OR Mancozeb 75% WP @ 400 g/acre in 200L water.

common_diseases.name: Collar Rot & Stem Rot / Sclerotium (మొదలు కుళ్ళు / తల కుళ్ళు)
common_diseases.symptoms: White fan-like fungal mycelium near the soil line with mustard-seed-like sclerotia, causing rotting of stem base and sudden wilting.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg seed. Apply 1 kg Trichoderma mixed in 100 kg FYM per acre.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 200 ml/acre drenching around collar region.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Avoid burying collar during weeding. PHI: 20 days.

groundnut.weather_sensitivity: Drought during pegging prevents pods from penetrating hard soil. Heavy rains near maturity cause pod sprouting inside the soil.

maize.name: Maize (మొక్కజొన్న / मक्का)
maize.suitable_soil: Deep, fertile, well-drained loams and silt loams with pH 6.0 to 7.5. Avoid saline/alkaline and waterlogged soils.
maize.sowing_and_spacing: Kharif: June-July; Rabi: Oct-Nov; Spring: Jan-Feb. Spacing: 60x20 cm. Seed rate: 7-8 kg/acre (hybrids).
maize.water_and_irrigation: Sensitive to waterlogging and drought. Critical stages: Knee-high stage, Tasseling, Silking, and Grain filling stage.
maize.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 48-60 kg N, 24 kg P2O5, 20 kg K2O per acre. Split N into 3 doses (basal, knee-high, tasseling). Apply Zinc Sulphate 10 kg/acre basal.

common_pests.name: Fall Armyworm (FAW / కత్తెర పురుగు / फॉल आर्मीवर्म - Spodoptera frugiperda)
common_pests.symptoms: Elongated papery feeding windows on leaves, extensive ragged holes on leaf whorls with sawdust-like coarse frass.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Install FAW pheromone traps @ 5/acre. Apply dry sand + neem cake powder (9:1) into leaf whorls. Spray Metarhizium anisopliae @ 5g/L.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If whorl damage > 10%: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 80 ml/acre OR Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 80-100 g/acre OR Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 100 ml/acre directed directly into plant whorls.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Direct spray nozzle into the central whorl where larvae hide. Wear mask and gloves. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Turcicum Leaf Blight & Maydis Blight (ఆకు ఎండు తెగులు)
common_diseases.symptoms: Long, spindle-shaped boat-shaped greyish-green or brown lesions on leaves, drying up large leaf areas.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Grow tolerant hybrids. Treat seeds with Mancozeb 2.5g/kg seed.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 200 ml/acre OR Mancozeb 75% WP @ 400 g/acre in 200L water.

maize.weather_sensitivity: Continuous waterlogging for >24 hours at seedling or flowering stage cuts grain yield drastically.

potato.name: Potato (బంగాళాదుంప / आलू)
potato.suitable_soil: Loose, friable sandy loam rich in organic matter with pH 5.2 to 6.4.
potato.sowing_and_spacing: Oct-Nov in Indo-Gangetic plains. Spacing: 60x20 cm. Seed rate: 12-16 quintals/acre of disease-free certified seed tubers.
potato.water_and_irrigation: Frequent light irrigations. Critical stages: Stolon formation, Tuber initiation (30-35 DAS), and Tuber bulking. Stop watering 10 days before harvesting for skin curing.
potato.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 60-80 kg N, 40-50 kg P2O5, 50-60 kg K2O per acre. Earthing up at 30-35 days prevents tuber greening.

common_pests.name: Potato Tuber Moth & Aphids (దుంప పురుగు మరియు పేనుబంక)
common_pests.symptoms: Moth larvae tunnel into tubers creating black frass-filled galleries. Aphids suck sap and transmit potato leaf roll virus.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Deep earthing up to keep tubers covered under at least 5 cm soil. Treat seed tubers with Thiamethoxam before cold storage.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 40g/acre for aphids; Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre in standing crop.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Wear mask and gloves. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Late Blight of Potato (ఆలస్యపు ఆకు ఎండు తెగులు / पछेती झुलसा - Phytophthora infestans)
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips/margins, purplish black blotches on stems, white mildew under leaves during cool misty mornings, rotten smelly tubers.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Spray prophylactic Mancozeb 75% WP @ 400 g/acre before cloudy foggy weather sets in.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: At onset of symptoms: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 400 g/acre OR Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 300 g/acre in 200L water.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Spray immediately upon weather warnings. Wear PPE. PHI: 7-10 days.

potato.weather_sensitivity: Foggy overcast weather with temperatures 10-20°C and RH >85% triggers destructive late blight epidemics within 48-72 hours.

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane (చెరకు / गन्ना)
sugarcane.suitable_soil: Deep, rich, well-drained loamy soils with pH 6.5 to 8.0.
sugarcane.sowing_and_spacing: Spring (Feb-March) or Autumn (Oct-Nov). Spacing: 90 cm or 120 cm (wide row). Seed rate: 25,000-30,000 two-budded setts/acre.
sugarcane.water_and_irrigation: High water requirement. Critical: Formative phase (60-120 days after planting) and grand growth phase. Drip irrigation saves 50% water.
sugarcane.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 100-120 kg N, 30-40 kg P2O5, 40-50 kg K2O per acre. Apply Nitrogen in 3 splits up to 90 days. Earthing up at 90-100 days.

common_pests.name: Early Shoot Borer & Top Borer (మొవ్వ తొలిచే పురుగు / तना छेदक)
common_pests.symptoms: Dead hearts in young shoots which can be easily pulled out, emitting foul odor; top borer produces bunchy top appearance.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Trash mulching @ 3 tonnes/acre. Release Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoids @ 20,000/acre. Light earthing up.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: Fipronil 0.3% GR @ 10 kg/acre applied in furrows at planting or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 150 ml/acre at 30-45 DAS.

common_diseases.name: Red Rot (ఎర్ర కుళ్ళు తెగులు / लाल सड़न - Colletotrichum)
common_diseases.symptoms: Third or fourth leaf from top yellows and withers; split cane shows internal red discoloration with characteristic white cross patches and alcohol smell.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Use certified red-rot free seed setts. Sett treatment in Carbendazim 0.1% for 15 mins. Strict crop rotation.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: No chemical cures internal red rot. Immediately rogue and burn infected clumps. Drench surrounding soil with Copper Oxychloride 3g/L.
common_diseases.safety_precautions: Do not take ratoon crop from red-rot infected field.

sugarcane.weather_sensitivity: Severe drought during formative stage stunts cane height and lowers sucrose accumulation.

pulses.name: Pulses - Chickpea / Pigeon Pea / Black Gram / Green Gram (పప్పు ధాన్యాలు / दालें)
pulses.suitable_soil: Well-drained medium to deep loamy or sandy loam soils. Chickpea thrives in black soils with neutral/mildly alkaline pH.
pulses.sowing_and_spacing: Chickpea: Oct-Nov (30x10 cm); Pigeon Pea: June-July (90x20 cm); Black/Green gram: Kharif & Summer (30x10 cm).
pulses.water_and_irrigation: Low water requirement. Critical: Pre-flowering and Pod development. Never irrigate during peak flowering (causes flower drop).
pulses.nutrient_and_fertilizer: NPK: 8-10 kg N, 20-25 kg P2O5, 10 kg K2O per acre. Treat seeds with Rhizobium + PSB bio-fertilizers (200g/acre each) to fix atmospheric nitrogen.

common_pests.name: Gram Pod Borer (శనగ కాయ తొలిచే పురుగు / फली छेदक - Helicoverpa armigera)
common_pests.symptoms: Caterpillars feed on foliage initially, then bore circular holes into pods, inserting their head inside while body remains outside.
common_pests.ipm_practices: Install 'T' shaped bird perches @ 20/acre. Pheromone traps @ 5/acre. Spray NPV (Nuclear Polyhedrosis Virus) @ 100 LE/acre.
common_pests.safe_chemical_control: If 1 larva per meter row: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 80-100 g/acre OR Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre in 200L water.
common_pests.safety_precautions: Wear mask and gloves. Avoid spraying during active bee foraging hours. PHI: 14 days.

common_diseases.name: Fusarium Wilt (ఎండు తెగులు / उकठा रोग)
common_diseases.symptoms: Drooping of petioles and leaves, yellowing and drying up of plant within a few days; dark brown xylem discoloration inside split root.
common_diseases.preventive_measures: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg seed. Crop rotation with sorghum/wheat. Deep summer ploughing.
common_diseases.safe_treatment: Soil drenching around affected patch with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3g/L.

pulses.weather_sensitivity: Rainfall or overcast foggy weather at flowering causes massive flower dropping and induces fungal ascochyta/botrytis blights.

soil_health_and_fertility: Conduct soil testing every 2-3 years through the Soil Health Card scheme before major crop cycles.
Incorporate 4-5 tonnes of well-decomposed Farmyard Manure (FYM) or 1-2 tonnes vermicompost per acre to enhance organic carbon and beneficial microbes.
Apply gypsum in oilseeds and pulses to provide essential Calcium and Sulphur for pod and oil synthesis.
Avoid indiscriminate use of urea without balancing with phosphorus, potash, and micronutrients.
integrated_pest_management_ipm: Step 1 (Cultural): Deep summer ploughing to expose pupae to sun and predatory birds; maintain clean field bunds.
Step 2 (Mechanical): Install pheromone traps (5/acre for monitoring, 10-15/acre for mass trapping) and sticky traps (yellow for whiteflies/aphids, blue for thrips).
Step 3 (Biological): Conserve natural predators (ladybird beetles, spiders, chrysoperla) and apply bio-pesticides (Neem formulations, Trichoderma, Bacillus thuringiensis, Beauveria bassiana).

Step 4 (Chemical): Use targeted, approved crop-protection chemicals strictly when Economic Threshold Levels (ETL) are breached, strictly respecting verified dosage, PPE, and Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI).
weather_smart_irrigation: Check 24-48 hour rainfall forecasts before scheduling irrigation to save energy, water, and prevent root waterlogging.
Irrigate during early morning or evening hours to minimize evaporation losses.
Adopt micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) under PMKSY subsidies to achieve up to 50% water savings and 20-30% yield enhancements.
chemical_pesticide_safety_rules: Always verify that the active ingredient and formulation are officially recommended for the specific crop and target pest.
Wear mandatory Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): respirator mask, chemical-resistant gloves, eye goggles, and full-sleeved clothing.
Never spray against the wind direction, during high winds (>15 km/h), or when rainfall is expected within 4-6 hours.
Do not eat, drink, or smoke while handling agricultural chemicals. Wash hands and face thoroughly with soap after spraying.
Strictly respect the Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) between the final chemical spray and crop harvest for safe food consumption.
Store all crop protection products in original containers locked safely away from children, livestock, and food items.
